subject: ArborHealth Exec Workshop — onsite agenda + presenter pre-read plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Timmons <sara.timmons@arborhealth.com>, Mike Jennings <mike.jennings@arborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ArborHealth Exec Workshop — onsite agenda + presenter pre-read plan

Team & Sara / Mike —

Thanks again for the heads-up on the ArborHealth exec workshop (March 11–12). I pulled together a small draft to help us lock owners and deliverables ahead of the program team kickoff next week. Key asks below:

- Confirm speaker owners for the five executive slots (30 / 20 / 15 / 10 / 10 minutes).
- Agree on one-page exec pre-read (CEO summary + 3 bullets of impact) — see outline attached.
- Travel windows and AV needs (Jordan to confirm on AV run-of-show + mic counts).
- Final agenda to be shared with customer by EOD Monday (15 Feb).

Draft attached: agenda-draft-v1.pdf (comments welcome). I also uploaded a working folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2BxQ_ArborOnsite

Proposed quick owners (feel free to reassign):
- 30m opening: Marissa Cole (context & success metrics)
- 20m platform update: Kimberly Park (product roadmap + performance highlights)
- 15m integration case study: Vanessa Ortiz (customer story + outcomes)
- 10m ops & security: Jordan Blake (SLA/ops ask + audit notes)
- 10m closing / next steps: Marissa Cole + Kimberly Park

Deadlines:
- Draft exec pre-read (1 pager) due Thu 2/12 COB — attach as exec-pre-read-outline.docx
- Slide decks for 30/20/15m due Mon 2/16 COB

Notes: ArborHealth asked for a concise one-pager for the C-suite and prefers no more than 6 slides per presenter for their limited executive time.

Can each of you reply with (a) confirm owner, (b) any AV/travel blockers, and (c) whether you can produce the 1-pager by Thu? Sara / Mike — feel free to jump in with preferences on timing or content scope.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda-draft-v1.pdf, exec-pre-read-outline.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Timmons <sara.timmons@arborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ArborHealth Exec Workshop — onsite agenda + presenter pre-read plan

Vanessa — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. Confirming owners below and a couple of clarifying notes.

Confirmations:
- 30m opening: Marissa Cole — confirmed. Will align with Sara on the top-of-day framing.
- 20m platform update: Kimberly Park — confirmed. I will focus on latency/cost improvements and the new rollout policies.
- 15m integration case study: Vanessa Ortiz — confirmed.
- 10m ops & security: Jordan Blake — @Jordan please confirm AV / audit artifacts.
- Closing: Marissa + me — we will own next steps and mutual action plan.

Pre-read: I can take the exec-pre-read-outline.docx and convert to a one-pager. I’ll aim to send a draft by Thu 2/12 4pm PT. Can the team try to limit each section to 2–3 bullets so we keep it succinct for the execs.

Logistics question: Are any execs arriving the night before? If so, we should propose a brief dinner (30–45m) for the host/customer execs and our two leads — would help set context. Sara / Mike, can you confirm arrival windows?

Thanks — Kim

All — quick AV / travel check from my side. Attached is a travel/ops lane spreadsheet (presenter-travel-lanes.xlsx) with tentative flights and hotel blocks. A few notes:

- AV: Room A (main session) will need 2 lapel mics + 1 handheld; projector + HDMI and a wireless confidence monitor. We should plan a 45-minute tech check on the morning of 3/11 (7:30–8:15am) before attendees arrive.
- Arrivals: I show two execs arriving 3/10 evening and the rest morning of 3/11. If there is a VIP dinner, recommend 7pm on 3/10 at the hotel to keep travel simple.
- Deck format: 16:9 slides; please embed any short demo videos as MP4 (no streaming).

Action items:
- Vanessa: confirm VIP dinner preference with Sara / Mike.
- Marissa / Kim: please upload final decks to the Drive folder by Mon 2/16 COB and flag any large assets >50MB so I can coordinate with AV.

I’ll update the travel spreadsheet as air tickets are confirmed.

Thanks — Jordan
Operations Lead, Customer Solutions

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the detailed plan — this looks good and we appreciate the succinct approach. A few confirmations from our side:

- Arrival windows: Two of our execs (CEO + SVP Ops) will arrive the evening of 3/10. The remainder arrive morning 3/11. Dinner on 3/10 at 7pm works for us — small, informal.
- One-pager: We absolutely prefer a one-page executive brief. Can you make sure the first section is a 2–3 sentence business outcome statement (top-line impact) followed by 3 bullets of evidence (metrics / one customer example / timeline).
- AV: lapels for all presenters + confidence monitor required — thanks Jordan.

We’ll confirm attendee list next week and share headshots for badges. If you need any background numbers I can pull a brief market slide for context.

Appreciate it — Sara
VP, Strategic Programs
ArborHealth
